title: Rustlung
prompt: complex upbeat bassline with roaring synths
description: A roaring FM-core bass-lead that prowls the full register, its harmonicity and fm index climbing on slow primes while a ladder filter snarls underneath. Over a 32-cycle arc a coarse/crush degradation ramp corrodes the tone from clean roar to broken, bit-mangled aggression and back.
code:
setcpm(140/4)
stack(
  note("<c1 c1 [eb1 g1] c2 g0 c1 [bb0 c1] eb1>*4").s("sawtooth")
    .fm(sine.slow(19).range(2, 13)).fmh("<1 1.5 2 0.5 3>/4")
    .penv("<0 0 12 -7>/8").pattack(0.001).pdecay(0.07)
    .coarse(sine.slow(32).range(1, 9).round())
    .crush(saw.slow(24).range(16, 5))
    .lpf(sine.slow(23).range(300, 4200)).resonance(15).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(4).lpattack(0.004).lpdecay(0.14)
    .attack(0.003).decay(0.18).sustain(0.55).release(0.05)
    .shape(sine.slow(16).range(0.2, 0.6))
    .vib("<3 5 7>/8").vibmod(sine.slow(13).range(0.1, 1.2))
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.2, 0.8))
    .sometimesBy(0.12, x => x.speed(-1))
    .off(1/8, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.28).pan(0.75).crush(6))
    .room(0.18).gain(0.9)
)
